country_event = {
	id = 170001
	title = "EVTNAME170001"
	desc = "EVTDESC170001"
	picture = "Administration"
	trigger = {
		has_country_modifier = wants_province_1680
		NOT = {
			owns = 1680
		}
		1680 = {
			controller = {
				OR = {
					tag = THIS
					AND = {
						alliance_with = THIS
						NOT = {
							has_country_modifier = wants_province_1680
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
		OR = {
			1680 = {
				any_neighbor_province = {
					owned_by = THIS
				}
			}
			AND = {
				num_of_ports = 1
				1680 = {
					port = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	mean_time_to_happen = {
		months = 3
	}
	option = {
		name = "EVTOPTA170001"
		1680 = {
			owner = {
				country_event = { id=170002 days=0 }
			}
		}
		1680 = {
			secede_province = THIS
		}
		1680 = {
			add_province_modifier = {
				name = wanted_by_someone
				duration = -1
			}
		}
		prestige = 4
	}
}

	id = 170145
	title = "EVTNAME170145"
	desc = "EVTDESC170145"
	picture = "Administration"
	trigger = {
		has_country_modifier = wants_province_1704
		NOT = {
			owns = 1704
		}
		1704 = {
			controller = {
				OR = {
					tag = THIS
					AND = {
						alliance_with = THIS
						NOT = {
							has_country_modifier = wants_province_1704
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
		OR = {
			1704 = {
				any_neighbor_province = {
					owned_by = THIS
				}
			}
			AND = {
				num_of_ports = 1
				1704 = {
					port = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	mean_time_to_happen = {
		months = 3
	}
	option = {
		name = "EVTOPTA170145"
		1704 = {
			owner = {
				country_event = { id=170146 days=0 }
			}
		}
		1704 = {
			secede_province = THIS
		}
		1704 = {
			add_province_modifier = {
				name = wanted_by_someone
				duration = -1
			}
		}
		prestige = 4
	}
}

	title = "EVTNAME170433"
	desc = "EVTDESC170433"
	picture = "Administration"
	trigger = {
		has_country_modifier = wants_province_1753
		NOT = {
			owns = 1753
		}
		1753 = {
			controller = {
				OR = {
					tag = THIS
					AND = {
						alliance_with = THIS
						NOT = {
							has_country_modifier = wants_province_1753
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
		OR = {
			1753 = {
				any_neighbor_province = {
					owned_by = THIS
				}
			}
			AND = {
				num_of_ports = 1
				1753 = {
					port = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	mean_time_to_happen = {
		months = 3
	}
	option = {
		name = "EVTOPTA170433"
		1753 = {
			owner = {
				country_event = { id=170434 days=0 }
			}
		}
		1753 = {
			secede_province = THIS
		}
		1753 = {
			add_province_modifier = {
				name = wanted_by_someone
				duration = -1
			}
		}
		prestige = 4
	}
}

					tag = THIS

						NOT = {

					}
				}
			}
		}
		OR = {
			1770 = {
				any_neighbor_province = {
					owned_by = THIS
				}
			}
			AND = {
				num_of_ports = 1
				1770 = {
					port = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	mean_time_to_happen = {
		months = 0.1
	}
	option = {
		name = "EVTOPTA170519"
		1770 = {
			owner = {

			}
		}
		1770 = {

		}
		1785 = {
			controller = {
				OR = {
					tag = THIS
					AND = {

						NOT = {

						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
		OR = {
			1785 = {
				any_neighbor_province = {
					owned_by = THIS
				}
			}
			AND = {
				num_of_ports = 1
				1785 = {
					port = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	mean_time_to_happen = {
		months = 3
	}

			}
		}
		1785 = {
			secede_province = THIS
		}
		1785 = {
			add_province_modifier = {
				name = wanted_by_someone
				duration = -1
			}
		}
		prestige = 4
	}

			}

		OR = {

					owned_by = THIS
				}
			}
			AND = {
				num_of_ports = 1

					port = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	mean_time_to_happen = {

	}

	option = {
		name = "EVTOPTA172654"

			name = wants_province_2129_back
			duration = -1
		}
		prestige = -2
	}
}
country_event = {
	id = 172655
	title = "EVTNAME172655"
	desc = "EVTDESC172655"
	picture = "Administration"
	trigger = {
		has_country_modifier = wants_province_2129_back
		NOT = {
			owns = 2129
		}
		2129 = {
			controller = {
				OR = {
					tag = THIS
					AND = {
						alliance_with = THIS
						NOT = {
							has_country_modifier = wants_province_2129
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
		OR = {
			2129 = {
				any_neighbor_province = {
					owned_by = THIS
				}
			}
			AND = {
				num_of_ports = 1
				2129 = {
					port = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	mean_time_to_happen = {
		months = 0.1
	}
	option = {
		name = "EVTOPTA172655"
		2129 = {
			owner = {
				country_event = { id=172656 days=0 }
			}
		}
		2129 = {
			secede_province = THIS
		}
		2129 = {
			add_province_modifier = {
				name = wanted_by_someone
				duration = -1
			}
		}
		prestige = 4
	}
}

country_event = {
	id = 173201
	title = "EVTNAME173201"
	desc = "EVTDESC173201"
	picture = "Administration"
	trigger = {
		has_country_modifier = wants_province_1393_back
		NOT = {
			owns = 1393
		}
		1393 = {
			controller = {
				OR = {
					tag = THIS
					AND = {
						alliance_with = THIS
						NOT = {
							has_country_modifier = wants_province_1393
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
		OR = {
			1393 = {
				any_neighbor_province = {
					owned_by = THIS
				}
			}
			AND = {
				num_of_ports = 1
				1393 = {
					port = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	mean_time_to_happen = {
		months = 0.1
	}
	option = {
		name = "EVTOPTA173201"
		1393 = {
			owner = {
				country_event = { id=173202 days=0 }
			}
		}
		1393 = {
			secede_province = THIS
		}
		1393 = {
			add_province_modifier = {
				name = wanted_by_someone
				duration = -1
			}
		}
		prestige = 4
	}
}

	title = "EVTNAME173373"
	desc = "EVTDESC173373"
	picture = "Administration"
	trigger = {
		has_country_modifier = wants_province_2572
		NOT = {
			owns = 2572
		}
		2572 = {
			controller = {
				OR = {
					tag = THIS
					AND = {
						alliance_with = THIS
						NOT = {
							has_country_modifier = wants_province_2572
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
		OR = {
			2572 = {
				any_neighbor_province = {
					owned_by = THIS
				}
			}
			AND = {
				num_of_ports = 1
				2572 = {
					port = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	mean_time_to_happen = {
		months = 3
	}
	option = {
		name = "EVTOPTA173373"
		2572 = {
			owner = {
				country_event = { id=173374 days=0 }
			}
		}
		2572 = {
			secede_province = THIS
		}
		2572 = {
			add_province_modifier = {
				name = wanted_by_someone
				duration = -1
			}
		}
		prestige = 4
	}
}

country_event = {
	id = 173833
	title = "EVTNAME173833"
	desc = "EVTDESC173833"
	picture = "Administration"
	trigger = {
		owns = 629
		war = no
		OR = {
			has_country_modifier = wants_province_629_back
			has_country_modifier = wants_province_629
		}
	}
	mean_time_to_happen = {
		months = 1
	}
	option = {
		name = "EVTOPTA173833"
		remove_country_modifier = wants_province_629_back
		remove_country_modifier = wants_province_629
		629 = {
			remove_province_modifier = wanted_by_someone
		}
		prestige = 2
	}
}
country_event = {

	desc = "EVTDESC173834"
	picture = "Administration"
	trigger = {

		}
		NOT = {

		}
		629 = {
			owner = {
				NOT = {

				}
			}
		}

	}

		remove_country_modifier = wants_province_629

country_event = {
	id = 173835
	title = "EVTNAME173835"
	desc = "EVTDESC173835"
	picture = "Administration"
	trigger = {
		has_country_modifier = wants_province_630
		NOT = {
			owns = 630
		}
		630 = {
			controller = {
				OR = {
					tag = THIS
					AND = {
						alliance_with = THIS
						NOT = {
							has_country_modifier = wants_province_630
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
		OR = {
			630 = {
				any_neighbor_province = {
					owned_by = THIS
				}
			}
			AND = {
				num_of_ports = 1
				630 = {
					port = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	mean_time_to_happen = {
		months = 3
	}
	option = {
		name = "EVTOPTA173835"
		630 = {
			owner = {
				country_event = { id=173836 days=0 }
			}
		}
		630 = {
			secede_province = THIS
		}
		630 = {
			add_province_modifier = {
				name = wanted_by_someone
				duration = -1
			}
		}
		prestige = 4
	}
}

country_event = {
	id = 174505
	title = "EVTNAME174505"
	desc = "EVTDESC174505"
	picture = "Administration"
	trigger = {
		owns = 808
		war = no
		OR = {
			has_country_modifier = wants_province_808_back
			has_country_modifier = wants_province_808
		}
	}
	mean_time_to_happen = {
		months = 1
	}
	option = {
		name = "EVTOPTA174505"
		remove_country_modifier = wants_province_808_back
		remove_country_modifier = wants_province_808
		808 = {
			remove_province_modifier = wanted_by_someone
		}
		prestige = 2
	}
}
country_event = {
	id = 174506
	title = "EVTNAME174506"
	desc = "EVTDESC174506"
	picture = "Administration"
	trigger = {
		OR = {
			has_country_modifier = wants_province_808_back
			has_country_modifier = wants_province_808
		}
		NOT = {
			owns = 808
		}
		808 = {
			owner = {
				NOT = {
					war_with = THIS
				}
			}
		}
	}
	mean_time_to_happen = {
		months = 1
	}
	option = {
		name = "EVTOPTA174506"
		remove_country_modifier = wants_province_808_back
		remove_country_modifier = wants_province_808
		prestige = -2
	}
}
country_event = {
	id = 174507
	title = "EVTNAME174507"
	desc = "EVTDESC174507"
	picture = "Administration"
	trigger = {
		has_country_modifier = wants_province_809
		NOT = {
			owns = 809
		}
		809 = {
			controller = {
				OR = {
					tag = THIS
					AND = {
						alliance_with = THIS
						NOT = {
							has_country_modifier = wants_province_809
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
		OR = {
			809 = {
				any_neighbor_province = {
					owned_by = THIS
				}
			}
			AND = {
				num_of_ports = 1
				809 = {
					port = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	mean_time_to_happen = {
		months = 3
	}
	option = {
		name = "EVTOPTA174507"
		809 = {
			owner = {
				country_event = { id=174508 days=0 }
			}
		}
		809 = {
			secede_province = THIS
		}
		809 = {
			add_province_modifier = {
				name = wanted_by_someone
				duration = -1
			}
		}
		prestige = 4
	}
}

	title = "EVTNAME175291"
	desc = "EVTDESC175291"
	picture = "Administration"
	trigger = {
		owns = 28
		war = no
		OR = {
			has_country_modifier = wants_province_28_back
			has_country_modifier = wants_province_28
		}
	}
	mean_time_to_happen = {
		months = 1
	}
	option = {
		name = "EVTOPTA175291"
		remove_country_modifier = wants_province_28_back
		remove_country_modifier = wants_province_28
		28 = {
			remove_province_modifier = wanted_by_someone
		}
		prestige = 2
	}
}

country_event = {
	id = 175293
	title = "EVTNAME175293"
	desc = "EVTDESC175293"
	picture = "Administration"
	trigger = {
		has_country_modifier = wants_province_29
		NOT = {
			owns = 29
		}
		29 = {
			controller = {
				OR = {
					tag = THIS
					AND = {
						alliance_with = THIS
						NOT = {
							has_country_modifier = wants_province_29
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
		OR = {
			29 = {
				any_neighbor_province = {
					owned_by = THIS
				}
			}
			AND = {
				num_of_ports = 1
				29 = {
					port = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	mean_time_to_happen = {
		months = 3
	}
	option = {
		name = "EVTOPTA175293"
		29 = {
			owner = {
				country_event = { id=175294 days=0 }
			}
		}
		29 = {
			secede_province = THIS
		}
		29 = {
			add_province_modifier = {
				name = wanted_by_someone
				duration = -1
			}
		}
		prestige = 4
	}
}

	title = "EVTNAME176624"
	desc = "EVTDESC176624"
	picture = "Administration"
	trigger = {
		OR = {
			has_country_modifier = wants_province_923_back
			has_country_modifier = wants_province_923
		}
		NOT = {
			owns = 923
		}
		923 = {
			owner = {
				NOT = {
					war_with = THIS
				}
			}
		}
	}
	mean_time_to_happen = {
		months = 1
	}
	option = {
		name = "EVTOPTA176624"
		remove_country_modifier = wants_province_923_back
		remove_country_modifier = wants_province_923
		prestige = -2
	}
}
country_event = {
	id = 176625
	title = "EVTNAME176625"
	desc = "EVTDESC176625"
	picture = "Administration"
	trigger = {
		has_country_modifier = wants_province_924
		NOT = {
			owns = 924
		}
		924 = {
			controller = {
				OR = {
					tag = THIS
					AND = {
						alliance_with = THIS
						NOT = {
							has_country_modifier = wants_province_924
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
		OR = {
			924 = {
				any_neighbor_province = {
					owned_by = THIS
				}
			}
			AND = {
				num_of_ports = 1
				924 = {
					port = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	mean_time_to_happen = {
		months = 3
	}
	option = {
		name = "EVTOPTA176625"
		924 = {
			owner = {
				country_event = { id=176626 days=0 }
			}
		}
		924 = {
			secede_province = THIS
		}
		924 = {
			add_province_modifier = {
				name = wanted_by_someone
				duration = -1
			}
		}
		prestige = 4
	}
}

	title = "EVTNAME177027"
	desc = "EVTDESC177027"
	picture = "Administration"
	trigger = {
		has_country_modifier = wants_province_1517
		NOT = {
			owns = 1517
		}
		1517 = {
			controller = {
				OR = {
					tag = THIS
					AND = {
						alliance_with = THIS
						NOT = {
							has_country_modifier = wants_province_1517
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
		OR = {
			1517 = {
				any_neighbor_province = {
					owned_by = THIS
				}
			}
			AND = {
				num_of_ports = 1
				1517 = {
					port = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	mean_time_to_happen = {
		months = 3
	}
	option = {
		name = "EVTOPTA177027"
		1517 = {
			owner = {
				country_event = { id=177028 days=0 }
			}
		}
		1517 = {
			secede_province = THIS
		}
		1517 = {
			add_province_modifier = {
				name = wanted_by_someone
				duration = -1
			}
		}
		prestige = 4
	}
}

	title = "EVTNAME177926"
	desc = "EVTDESC177926"
	picture = "Administration"
	trigger = {
		OR = {
			has_country_modifier = wants_province_445_back
			has_country_modifier = wants_province_445
		}
		NOT = {
			owns = 445
		}
		445 = {
			owner = {
				NOT = {
					war_with = THIS
				}
			}
		}
	}
	mean_time_to_happen = {
		months = 1
	}
	option = {
		name = "EVTOPTA177926"
		remove_country_modifier = wants_province_445_back
		remove_country_modifier = wants_province_445
		prestige = -2
	}
}
country_event = {
	id = 177927
	title = "EVTNAME177927"
	desc = "EVTDESC177927"
	picture = "Administration"
	trigger = {
		has_country_modifier = wants_province_446
		NOT = {
			owns = 446
		}
		446 = {
			controller = {
				OR = {
					tag = THIS
					AND = {
						alliance_with = THIS
						NOT = {
							has_country_modifier = wants_province_446
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
		OR = {
			446 = {
				any_neighbor_province = {
					owned_by = THIS
				}
			}
			AND = {
				num_of_ports = 1
				446 = {
					port = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	mean_time_to_happen = {
		months = 3
	}
	option = {
		name = "EVTOPTA177927"
		446 = {
			owner = {
				country_event = { id=177928 days=0 }
			}
		}
		446 = {
			secede_province = THIS
		}
		446 = {
			add_province_modifier = {
				name = wanted_by_someone
				duration = -1
			}
		}
		prestige = 4
	}
}

	id = 178571
	title = "EVTNAME178571"
	desc = "EVTDESC178571"
	picture = "Administration"
	trigger = {
		has_country_modifier = wants_province_603_back
		NOT = {
			owns = 603
		}
		603 = {
			controller = {
				OR = {
					tag = THIS
					AND = {
						alliance_with = THIS
						NOT = {
							has_country_modifier = wants_province_603
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
		OR = {
			603 = {
				any_neighbor_province = {
					owned_by = THIS
				}
			}
			AND = {
				num_of_ports = 1
				603 = {
					port = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	mean_time_to_happen = {
		months = 0.1
	}
	option = {
		name = "EVTOPTA178571"
		603 = {
			owner = {
				country_event = { id=178572 days=0 }
			}
		}
		603 = {
			secede_province = THIS
		}
		603 = {
			add_province_modifier = {
				name = wanted_by_someone
				duration = -1
			}
		}
		prestige = 4
	}
}

	title = "EVTNAME179612"
	desc = "EVTDESC179612"
	picture = "Administration"
	trigger = {
		OR = {
			has_country_modifier = wants_province_1440_back
			has_country_modifier = wants_province_1440
		}
		NOT = {
			owns = 1440
		}
		1440 = {
			owner = {
				NOT = {
					war_with = THIS
				}
			}
		}
	}
	mean_time_to_happen = {
		months = 1
	}
	option = {
		name = "EVTOPTA179612"
		remove_country_modifier = wants_province_1440_back
		remove_country_modifier = wants_province_1440
		prestige = -2
	}
}
country_event = {
	id = 179613
	title = "EVTNAME179613"
	desc = "EVTDESC179613"
	picture = "Administration"
	trigger = {
		has_country_modifier = wants_province_1441
		NOT = {
			owns = 1441
		}
		1441 = {
			controller = {
				OR = {
					tag = THIS
					AND = {
						alliance_with = THIS
						NOT = {
							has_country_modifier = wants_province_1441
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
		OR = {
			1441 = {
				any_neighbor_province = {
					owned_by = THIS
				}
			}
			AND = {
				num_of_ports = 1
				1441 = {
					port = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	mean_time_to_happen = {
		months = 3
	}
	option = {
		name = "EVTOPTA179613"
		1441 = {
			owner = {
				country_event = { id=179614 days=0 }
			}
		}
		1441 = {
			secede_province = THIS
		}
		1441 = {
			add_province_modifier = {
				name = wanted_by_someone
				duration = -1
			}
		}
		prestige = 4
	}
}

	id = 180365
	title = "EVTNAME180365"
	desc = "EVTDESC180365"

	trigger = {
		has_country_modifier = wants_province_388_back
		NOT = {
			owns = 388
		}
		388 = {
			controller = {
				OR = {
					tag = THIS
					AND = {
						alliance_with = THIS
						NOT = {
							has_country_modifier = wants_province_388
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
		OR = {
			388 = {
				any_neighbor_province = {
					owned_by = THIS
				}
			}
			AND = {
				num_of_ports = 1
				388 = {
					port = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	mean_time_to_happen = {
		months = 0.1
	}
	option = {
		name = "EVTOPTA180365"
		388 = {
			owner = {
				country_event = { id=180366 days=0 }
			}
		}
		388 = {
			secede_province = THIS
		}
		388 = {
			add_province_modifier = {
				name = wanted_by_someone
				duration = -1
			}
		}
		prestige = 4
	}

			owns = 2152
		}
		2152 = {
			controller = {
				OR = {
					tag = THIS
					AND = {
						alliance_with = THIS
						NOT = {
							has_country_modifier = wants_province_2152
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
		OR = {
			2152 = {
				any_neighbor_province = {
					owned_by = THIS
				}
			}
			AND = {
				num_of_ports = 1
				2152 = {
					port = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	mean_time_to_happen = {
		months = 0.1
	}
	option = {

		}

	title = "EVTNAME180626"
	desc = "EVTDESC180626"
	picture = "Administration"
	trigger = {
		OR = {
			has_country_modifier = wants_province_2161_back
			has_country_modifier = wants_province_2161
		}
		NOT = {
			owns = 2161
		}
		2161 = {
			owner = {
				NOT = {
					war_with = THIS
				}
			}
		}
	}
	mean_time_to_happen = {
		months = 1
	}
	option = {
		name = "EVTOPTA180626"
		remove_country_modifier = wants_province_2161_back
		remove_country_modifier = wants_province_2161
		prestige = -2
	}
}
country_event = {
	id = 180627
	title = "EVTNAME180627"
	desc = "EVTDESC180627"
	picture = "Administration"
	trigger = {
		has_country_modifier = wants_province_2162
		NOT = {
			owns = 2162
		}
		2162 = {
			controller = {
				OR = {
					tag = THIS
					AND = {
						alliance_with = THIS
						NOT = {
							has_country_modifier = wants_province_2162
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
		OR = {
			2162 = {
				any_neighbor_province = {
					owned_by = THIS
				}
			}
			AND = {
				num_of_ports = 1
				2162 = {
					port = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	mean_time_to_happen = {
		months = 3
	}
	option = {
		name = "EVTOPTA180627"
		2162 = {
			owner = {
				country_event = { id=180628 days=0 }
			}
		}
		2162 = {
			secede_province = THIS
		}
		2162 = {
			add_province_modifier = {
				name = wanted_by_someone
				duration = -1
			}
		}
		prestige = 4
	}
}

	title = "EVTNAME181496"
	desc = "EVTDESC181496"
	picture = "Administration"
	trigger = {
		OR = {
			has_country_modifier = wants_province_1723_back
			has_country_modifier = wants_province_1723
		}
		NOT = {
			owns = 1723
		}
		1723 = {
			owner = {
				NOT = {
					war_with = THIS
				}
			}
		}
	}
	mean_time_to_happen = {
		months = 1
	}
	option = {
		name = "EVTOPTA181496"
		remove_country_modifier = wants_province_1723_back
		remove_country_modifier = wants_province_1723
		prestige = -2
	}
}
country_event = {
	id = 181497
	title = "EVTNAME181497"
	desc = "EVTDESC181497"
	picture = "Administration"
	trigger = {
		has_country_modifier = wants_province_1979
		NOT = {
			owns = 1979
		}
		1979 = {
			controller = {
				OR = {
					tag = THIS
					AND = {
						alliance_with = THIS
						NOT = {
							has_country_modifier = wants_province_1979
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
		OR = {
			1979 = {
				any_neighbor_province = {
					owned_by = THIS
				}
			}
			AND = {
				num_of_ports = 1
				1979 = {
					port = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	mean_time_to_happen = {
		months = 3
	}
	option = {
		name = "EVTOPTA181497"
		1979 = {
			owner = {
				country_event = { id=181498 days=0 }
			}
		}
		1979 = {
			secede_province = THIS
		}
		1979 = {
			add_province_modifier = {
				name = wanted_by_someone
				duration = -1
			}
		}
		prestige = 4
	}
}

country_event = {
	id = 181525
	title = "EVTNAME181525"
	desc = "EVTDESC181525"
	picture = "Administration"
	trigger = {
		owns = 2187
		war = no
		OR = {
			has_country_modifier = wants_province_2187_back
			has_country_modifier = wants_province_2187
		}
	}
	mean_time_to_happen = {
		months = 1
	}
	option = {
		name = "EVTOPTA181525"
		remove_country_modifier = wants_province_2187_back
		remove_country_modifier = wants_province_2187
		2187 = {
			remove_province_modifier = wanted_by_someone
		}
		prestige = 2
	}
}
country_event = {
	id = 181526
	title = "EVTNAME181526"
	desc = "EVTDESC181526"
	picture = "Administration"
	trigger = {
		OR = {
			has_country_modifier = wants_province_2187_back
			has_country_modifier = wants_province_2187
		}
		NOT = {
			owns = 2187
		}
		2187 = {
			owner = {
				NOT = {
					war_with = THIS
				}
			}
		}
	}
	mean_time_to_happen = {
		months = 1
	}
	option = {
		name = "EVTOPTA181526"
		remove_country_modifier = wants_province_2187_back
		remove_country_modifier = wants_province_2187
		prestige = -2
	}

country_event = {
	id = 181527
	title = "EVTNAME181527"
	desc = "EVTDESC181527"
	picture = "Administration"
	trigger = {
		has_country_modifier = wants_province_2188
		NOT = {
			owns = 2188
		}
		2188 = {
			controller = {
				OR = {
					tag = THIS
					AND = {
						alliance_with = THIS
						NOT = {
							has_country_modifier = wants_province_2188
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
		OR = {
			2188 = {
				any_neighbor_province = {
					owned_by = THIS
				}
			}
			AND = {
				num_of_ports = 1
				2188 = {
					port = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	mean_time_to_happen = {
		months = 3
	}
	option = {
		name = "EVTOPTA181527"
		2188 = {
			owner = {
				country_event = { id=181528 days=0 }
			}
		}
		2188 = {
			secede_province = THIS
		}
		2188 = {
			add_province_modifier = {
				name = wanted_by_someone
				duration = -1
			}
		}
		prestige = 4
	}
}

country_event = {
	id = 181697
	title = "EVTNAME181697"
	desc = "EVTDESC181697"
	picture = "Administration"
	trigger = {
		has_country_modifier = wants_province_2248_back
		NOT = {
			owns = 2248
		}
		2248 = {
			controller = {
				OR = {
					tag = THIS
					AND = {
						alliance_with = THIS
						NOT = {
							has_country_modifier = wants_province_2248
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
		OR = {
			2248 = {
				any_neighbor_province = {
					owned_by = THIS
				}
			}
			AND = {
				num_of_ports = 1
				2248 = {
					port = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	mean_time_to_happen = {
		months = 0.1
	}
	option = {
		name = "EVTOPTA181697"
		2248 = {
			owner = {
				country_event = { id=181698 days=0 }
			}
		}
		2248 = {
			secede_province = THIS
		}
		2248 = {
			add_province_modifier = {
				name = wanted_by_someone
				duration = -1
			}
		}
		prestige = 4
	}
}

	title = "EVTNAME182013"
	desc = "EVTDESC182013"
	picture = "Administration"
	trigger = {
		has_country_modifier = wants_province_2301
		NOT = {
			owns = 2301
		}
		2301 = {
			controller = {
				OR = {
					tag = THIS
					AND = {
						alliance_with = THIS
						NOT = {
							has_country_modifier = wants_province_2301
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
		OR = {
			2301 = {
				any_neighbor_province = {
					owned_by = THIS
				}
			}
			AND = {
				num_of_ports = 1
				2301 = {
					port = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	mean_time_to_happen = {
		months = 3
	}
	option = {
		name = "EVTOPTA182013"
		2301 = {
			owner = {
				country_event = { id=182014 days=0 }
			}
		}
		2301 = {
			secede_province = THIS
		}
		2301 = {
			add_province_modifier = {
				name = wanted_by_someone
				duration = -1
			}
		}
		prestige = 4
	}
}

	title = "EVTNAME182157"
	desc = "EVTDESC182157"
	picture = "Administration"
	trigger = {
		has_country_modifier = wants_province_2325
		NOT = {
			owns = 2325
		}
		2325 = {
			controller = {
				OR = {
					tag = THIS
					AND = {
						alliance_with = THIS
						NOT = {
							has_country_modifier = wants_province_2325
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
		OR = {
			2325 = {
				any_neighbor_province = {
					owned_by = THIS
				}
			}
			AND = {
				num_of_ports = 1
				2325 = {
					port = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	mean_time_to_happen = {
		months = 3
	}
	option = {
		name = "EVTOPTA182157"
		2325 = {
			owner = {
				country_event = { id=182158 days=0 }
			}
		}
		2325 = {
			secede_province = THIS
		}
		2325 = {
			add_province_modifier = {
				name = wanted_by_someone
				duration = -1
			}
		}
		prestige = 4
	}
}

			}
		}
	}

country_event = {
	id = 182387
	title = "EVTNAME182387"
	desc = "EVTDESC182387"
	picture = "Administration"
	trigger = {
		has_country_modifier = wants_province_2364_back
		NOT = {
			owns = 2364
		}
		2364 = {
			controller = {
				OR = {
					tag = THIS
					AND = {
						alliance_with = THIS
						NOT = {
							has_country_modifier = wants_province_2364
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
		OR = {
			2364 = {
				any_neighbor_province = {
					owned_by = THIS
				}
			}
			AND = {
				num_of_ports = 1
				2364 = {
					port = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	mean_time_to_happen = {
		months = 0.1
	}
	option = {
		name = "EVTOPTA182387"
		2364 = {
			owner = {
				country_event = { id=182388 days=0 }
			}
		}
		2364 = {
			secede_province = THIS
		}
		2364 = {
			add_province_modifier = {
				name = wanted_by_someone
				duration = -1
			}
		}
		prestige = 4
	}
}

	title = "EVTNAME183335"
	desc = "EVTDESC183335"
	picture = "Administration"
	trigger = {
		has_country_modifier = wants_province_1052_back
		NOT = {
			owns = 1052
		}
		1052 = {
			controller = {
				OR = {
					tag = THIS
					AND = {
						alliance_with = THIS
						NOT = {
							has_country_modifier = wants_province_1052
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
		OR = {
			1052 = {
				any_neighbor_province = {
					owned_by = THIS
				}
			}
			AND = {
				num_of_ports = 1
				1052 = {
					port = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	mean_time_to_happen = {
		months = 0.1
	}
	option = {
		name = "EVTOPTA183335"
		1052 = {
			owner = {
				country_event = { id=183336 days=0 }
			}
		}
		1052 = {
			secede_province = THIS
		}
		1052 = {
			add_province_modifier = {
				name = wanted_by_someone
				duration = -1
			}
		}
		prestige = 4
	}
}

	title = "EVTNAME183421"
	desc = "EVTDESC183421"
	picture = "Administration"
	trigger = {
		owns = 1066
		war = no
		OR = {
			has_country_modifier = wants_province_1066_back
			has_country_modifier = wants_province_1066
		}
	}
	mean_time_to_happen = {
		months = 1
	}
	option = {
		name = "EVTOPTA183421"
		remove_country_modifier = wants_province_1066_back
		remove_country_modifier = wants_province_1066
		1066 = {
			remove_province_modifier = wanted_by_someone
		}
		prestige = 2
	}
}

country_event = {
	id = 183423
	title = "EVTNAME183423"
	desc = "EVTDESC183423"
	picture = "Administration"
	trigger = {
		has_country_modifier = wants_province_1067
		NOT = {
			owns = 1067
		}
		1067 = {
			controller = {
				OR = {
					tag = THIS
					AND = {
						alliance_with = THIS
						NOT = {
							has_country_modifier = wants_province_1067
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
		OR = {
			1067 = {
				any_neighbor_province = {
					owned_by = THIS
				}
			}
			AND = {
				num_of_ports = 1
				1067 = {
					port = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	mean_time_to_happen = {
		months = 3
	}
	option = {
		name = "EVTOPTA183423"
		1067 = {
			owner = {
				country_event = { id=183424 days=0 }
			}
		}
		1067 = {
			secede_province = THIS
		}
		1067 = {
			add_province_modifier = {
				name = wanted_by_someone
				duration = -1
			}
		}
		prestige = 4
	}
}

	title = "EVTNAME183593"
	desc = "EVTDESC183593"
	picture = "Administration"
	trigger = {
		has_country_modifier = wants_province_1102_back
		NOT = {
			owns = 1102
		}
		1102 = {
			controller = {
				OR = {
					tag = THIS
					AND = {
						alliance_with = THIS
						NOT = {
							has_country_modifier = wants_province_1102
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
		OR = {
			1102 = {
				any_neighbor_province = {
					owned_by = THIS
				}
			}
			AND = {
				num_of_ports = 1
				1102 = {
					port = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	mean_time_to_happen = {
		months = 0.1
	}
	option = {
		name = "EVTOPTA183593"
		1102 = {
			owner = {
				country_event = { id=183594 days=0 }
			}
		}
		1102 = {
			secede_province = THIS
		}
		1102 = {
			add_province_modifier = {
				name = wanted_by_someone
				duration = -1
			}
		}
		prestige = 4
	}
}

	title = "EVTNAME184431"
	desc = "EVTDESC184431"
	picture = "Administration"
	trigger = {
		has_country_modifier = wants_province_713
		NOT = {
			owns = 713
		}
		713 = {
			controller = {
				OR = {
					tag = THIS
					AND = {
						alliance_with = THIS
						NOT = {
							has_country_modifier = wants_province_713
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
		OR = {
			713 = {
				any_neighbor_province = {
					owned_by = THIS
				}
			}
			AND = {
				num_of_ports = 1
				713 = {
					port = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	mean_time_to_happen = {
		months = 3
	}
	option = {
		name = "EVTOPTA184431"
		713 = {
			owner = {
				country_event = { id=184432 days=0 }
			}
		}
		713 = {
			secede_province = THIS
		}
		713 = {
			add_province_modifier = {
				name = wanted_by_someone
				duration = -1
			}
		}
		prestige = 4
	}
}

	desc = "EVTDESC184983"
	picture = "Administration"
	trigger = {
		has_country_modifier = wants_province_500
		NOT = {
			owns = 500
		}
		500 = {
			controller = {
				OR = {
					tag = THIS
					AND = {
						alliance_with = THIS
						NOT = {
							has_country_modifier = wants_province_500
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
		OR = {
			500 = {
				any_neighbor_province = {
					owned_by = THIS
				}
			}
			AND = {
				num_of_ports = 1
				500 = {
					port = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	mean_time_to_happen = {
		months = 3
	}
	option = {
		name = "EVTOPTA184983"
		500 = {
			owner = {
				country_event = { id=184984 days=0 }
			}
		}
		500 = {
			secede_province = THIS
		}
		500 = {
			add_province_modifier = {
				name = wanted_by_someone
				duration = -1
			}
		}
		prestige = 4
	}
}

	title = "EVTNAME185630"
	desc = "EVTDESC185630"
	picture = "Administration"
	trigger = {
		OR = {
			has_country_modifier = wants_province_142_back
			has_country_modifier = wants_province_142
		}
		NOT = {
			owns = 142
		}
		142 = {
			owner = {
				NOT = {
					war_with = THIS
				}
			}
		}
	}
	mean_time_to_happen = {
		months = 1
	}
	option = {
		name = "EVTOPTA185630"
		remove_country_modifier = wants_province_142_back
		remove_country_modifier = wants_province_142
		prestige = -2
	}
}
country_event = {
	id = 185631
	title = "EVTNAME185631"
	desc = "EVTDESC185631"
	picture = "Administration"
	trigger = {
		has_country_modifier = wants_province_143
		NOT = {
			owns = 143
		}
		143 = {
			controller = {
				OR = {
					tag = THIS
					AND = {
						alliance_with = THIS
						NOT = {
							has_country_modifier = wants_province_143
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
		OR = {
			143 = {
				any_neighbor_province = {
					owned_by = THIS
				}
			}
			AND = {
				num_of_ports = 1
				143 = {
					port = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	mean_time_to_happen = {
		months = 3
	}
	option = {
		name = "EVTOPTA185631"
		143 = {
			owner = {
				country_event = { id=185632 days=0 }
			}
		}
		143 = {
			secede_province = THIS
		}
		143 = {
			add_province_modifier = {
				name = wanted_by_someone
				duration = -1
			}
		}
		prestige = 4
	}
}

	id = 186129
	title = "EVTNAME186129"
	desc = "EVTDESC186129"
	picture = "Administration"
	trigger = {
		has_country_modifier = wants_province_226
		NOT = {
			owns = 226
		}
		226 = {
			controller = {
				OR = {
					tag = THIS
					AND = {
						alliance_with = THIS
						NOT = {
							has_country_modifier = wants_province_226
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
		OR = {
			226 = {
				any_neighbor_province = {
					owned_by = THIS
				}
			}
			AND = {
				num_of_ports = 1
				226 = {
					port = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	mean_time_to_happen = {
		months = 3
	}
	option = {
		name = "EVTOPTA186129"
		226 = {
			owner = {
				country_event = { id=186130 days=0 }
			}
		}
		226 = {
			secede_province = THIS
		}
		226 = {
			add_province_modifier = {
				name = wanted_by_someone
				duration = -1
			}
		}
		prestige = 4
	}
}
